# Refactor integration — bounded adapters, real gates

## Mode and source contract

Same lifecycle task/readiness and original scope, one owner; no child registration,
closure, app mutation, Git or successor. Human actual decisions go to human;
full DAO and hybrid bounded guidance uses common message_context/instruction_units/execution_plan.
Human and hybrid require human completion/route confirmation; full DAO selects
only authorized successors. Scope or
contract changes require actual human CR authority before behavior change in every
mode. Clear authority needs no repeated approval.

Explicit source link first, declared feature/source links, unique EPIC/FEATURE
then validated legacy feature folder. Keep anchors, check kind/content/identity,
approved-root containment, traversal and symlink escape. Explicit broken or
ambiguous link blocks, not fallback. Inspect dependencies separately from write
scope. No whole-project retrofit or new goal database/board fields.

| Mode | Analysis / Sync | Verification and completion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| study-only | Read-only inspected scope and gaps; no source/test/doc mutation except authorized analysis report | Recommendations, not implementation or achieved improvement; no source baseline all-green required to study |
| local | Scoped analysis and targeted sync of affected documentation; no blanket 80% or full-global docs prerequisite | targeted risk-based tests and comparable named improvement; applicable build/lint and affected callers |
| broad | Expanded authorized scope with justified cross-module dependencies and sync | Relevant integration/full suite, measured coverage where applicable with same-method baseline; no unrelated global repair |

## Installed analysis and sync output — do not invent support

Load the selected analysis or sync contract only when its expertise is needed.
Current full_analysis/full_sync operations accept study-only/local/broad scope;
invoke in the same agent loop, preserving actual operation_output and supplied
goal/scope/quality/suggestion/principle fields. Full means relevant perspectives,
not global rewrites, blanket alignment or new score/coverage work.

Reuse fresh scoped analysis and preservation evidence rather than generating a
second report pipeline. Inline bounded inspection is sufficient when the requested
refactor is already clear and these tools add no information; record what was
actually inspected, not a fictitious tool invocation. Study is read-only except
its authorized report; local updates only affected approved docs/tests. Required
numeric consumers need real comparable measurements; unknown is null/explicit
not measured under their actual schema, never an invented success score.
Unavailable tools or not_found source evidence are gaps, not a successful tool
invocation. Use no synthetic metric and do not skip failing tests.

## Legacy task output typing and evidence

Entry preserves original task output shape and all dynamic fields. Only designated
quality_score_before/after string fields now explicitly allow not measured.
Named improvement evidence and trade-offs live in report, not arbitrary totals.
Counts stay actual; goals achieved/partial/skipped reflect real implementation,
not automatic study success. Engineering evidence is not stakeholder observation.

Coverage keeps the original before/after/status keys. This authorized schema delta
allows percentage string | null for before/after, and maintained | improved |
degraded | null for status. Null is actual YAML/JSON null, not a numeric sentinel,
string "null", enum "not measured" or retained declaration placeholder. With
unmeasured/non-applicable coverage return all three keys with null and explain
not measured plus applicability/evidence in report. With only one measured side,
retain it and null the missing side and comparison. With two non-comparable
measurements retain both, null status, disclose the incompatible method/scope.
Comparable measured inputs alone justify maintained/improved/degraded. A required
measurement still blocks its claim; optional study/local metrics do not force 80%
or global repair. A downstream strict legacy consumer rejecting null blocks that
consumer handoff until verified integration; never coerce null to zero/success.
This candidate makes no blanket runtime-compatibility claim.

## Implementation routing and special skill route

Read actual stages.validation.code_refactor in tools.json, including `_extra_instruction`.
Discover actual implementation tools, semantically match runtime/layer, group AAA
preservation scenarios and route sequentially with operation: refactor, source/
test paths and actual optional feature_context as permitted by each loaded tool.
Preserve exact operation_output success/result/files/assert-level results/lint/
errors and cross-layer boundaries. No inline production fallback.

Missing/empty route retains documented legacy discovery default; nonempty is
opt-in. Explicit true enables, explicit false disables, metadata keys are not
tools. No force-enabling general fallback when explicitly disabled. No matching
enabled/available tool means mutation blocked, not arbitrary inline edits. Study
can record recommendations without implementation. Config's legacy checkpoint
instruction is advisory tool context, not Git permission; common lifecycle default
no commit and protected dirty bytes override automatic checkpoint behavior.

Python refactor explicitly permits absent feature_context and tool-local synthetic
REFACTOR-task with technical_design_link N/A. This is not actual feature allocation,
app identity or created design. It requires baseline tests pass; do not tell it
baseline passed when it did not. Load each other tool's own exception/DoR; no
assumed cross-tool support or manufactured context.

Skill-package target is a special mandatory creator route, NOT an arbitrary enabled
language-tool selection: load x-ipe-meta-skill-creator, pass same task/readiness,
complete candidate resources/root metadata, validate/review, and separately
publish only with authority. This is not arbitrary production edits; no generic
tool may bypass candidate staging or a genuinely required review. Code_refactor config
remains authoritative for ordinary implementation routes; no new config entry or
silent enabling of creator required for this skill-management responsibility.

## Actual app association and conditional report

ACTION_MAP maps this skill to code_refactor, validation per_feature. Both default
templates declare it optional. Refactor only for an evidenced need or explicit
request; no-need delivery routes acceptance directly to closing. A project's
explicit customized mandatory action still binds.

When refactoring is actually performed, required contexts remain tech-design and
specification; test-report is optional. Return a real refactor-report. Owner
alone performs one authorized workflow_update_action.py --workflow actual-name
--action code_refactor --status done --feature-id actual-id --deliverables keyed
JSON and verifies readback/files/identity. Free-mode has no app writes. Study-only
does not pretend structural work occurred or publish a fake done/report to unlock
closing. Service-initialized optional skipped is not evidence of refactor execution.
Writer success alone is insufficient to prove preservation or required
predecessors. No fake done, skipped or report writes to unblock routing.

## Evidence, tracing and review

Source/test/design/config/review hashes bind each actual command/exit/result.
Changes invalidate affected evidence; preserve unrelated history. New regressions
block, baseline failures/unavailable checks stay named. UI evidence requires real
configured/available browser when pertinent; no jsdom/fixture as browser proof.
Consult tracing_enabled/infrastructure and retain existing decorators/redaction;
disabled/absent does not force installation. Use self-checks and targeted tests by default; independent review is required only for an explicit request or concrete high-risk uncertainty under the shared single-loop policy. Reuse suitable current review; missing required review blocks the affected claim, not drafting.
